verdict.summary: Round 2 resolves the prior major finding. The T0 declaration regex now requires a structural field-slot boundary (line start/list prefix, pipe separator, or sentence break), so both ordinary mid-sentence `surface:` prose and `foo::surface:` decline T0. The focused tests cover those exact prior counterexamples and include positive anti-vacuity cases for every supported layout; the full targeted unittest module passes (20 tests). The same change also adds sound non-vacuity checks to the title/text scope tests. No correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security issue remains in the diff.
